title: impatiens javensis
intro: Impatiens javensis, commonly known as Balsam or Javan Balsam, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving respiratory issues, and soothing digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Impatiens javensis include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of bronchitis, coughs, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Impatiens javensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and coumarins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
